name: redhead-supermodel-moment
image_vibe: Bold elegant copper-red beauty with glove-forward depth and clean cinematic studio minimalism
image_purpose: Create a modern high-fashion editorial portrait for lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A high-fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman with copper-red hair and a gloved hand reaching toward the lens.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long copper-red wavy hair, pale natural skin with realistic texture, soft neutral makeup, natural lips, and a calm confident expression. She wears a black corset-style bodysuit, sheer black tights, and semi-transparent black gloves, presented in a non-explicit editorial composition.
prompt.composition_elements: Chest-level portrait with the subject leaning slightly toward camera, one gloved hand reaching toward the lens to create depth, face sharp and foreground hand slightly blurred, clean light-neutral minimal studio background, and shallow depth of field.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional studio lighting from a visible softbox at frame edge, gentle highlights on skin, subtle sculpting shadows, bold elegant cinematic fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Chest-level perspective, shallow depth of field, professional fashion photography, realistic hair, glove, tights, skin, and fabric texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-fashion photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman with long copper-red wavy hair, pale natural skin with realistic texture, soft neutral makeup, natural lips, and a calm confident expression. Dress her in a black corset-style bodysuit, sheer black tights, and semi-transparent black gloves in a non-explicit editorial composition. Lean her slightly toward the camera at chest level, with one gloved hand reaching toward the lens to create depth; keep the face sharp and the foreground hand slightly blurred. Use a clean light-neutral minimal studio background, soft directional lighting from a visible softbox at the frame edge, gentle highlights on the skin, subtle sculpting shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic hair, glove, tights, skin, and fabric texture, subtle film grain, cinematic editorial polish, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed glove, duplicate hand, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source copper-red glove-forward portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for copper-red hair, black styling, reaching-glove depth effect, softbox edge, light neutral background, and cinematic editorial mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, copper-red hair, black outfit, glove-forward perspective, sharp face, light neutral studio, and bold elegant fashion direction. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult and explicitly framed the source outfit and pose as non-explicit editorial fashion.
